meta.title: Privacy Notice — Forcelis
meta.description: How Forcelis handles the personal data it receives through this website, its consulting services and its platform for advisors.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what data Forcelis receives through this website, what it is used for and what you can do about it. Information in a consulting project or a platform account is also governed by the contract or terms signed for that service.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: Forcelis Group is responsible for the personal data collected through this website. You can reach us through the channel at the end of this notice for anything related to it.

sections.title: What this site collects
body: Only what you type into the contact form: name, email, business or company name, line of business or industry, number of locations, city or country, the service you're interested in and your message. If you book a call, the external calendar receives the details you enter there.
The site does not ask for — and should never be used to send — tax portal credentials, bank passwords, card or account numbers, or official identification numbers.

sections.title: What it is used for
body: To reply to your request, understand whether Forcelis can help and, if you ask for one, prepare a proposal. It is not used for anything else and is never sold or rented.

sections.title: Data in a project or on the platform
body: In a consulting project we work with the electronic invoices (CFDI) and the information you provide, only for the contracted analysis. On the platform for advisors, each company is isolated from the others.

A company's data is only used in the anonymous benchmark if that company authorizes it in writing. This also applies to advisors using the platform's launch offer: the benchmark authorization is signed client by client, and without it no data is included.

sections.title: Who else sees it
body: Form submissions are delivered by an external form provider that processes them on our behalf, solely to deliver the message. Call scheduling uses an external calendar. Beyond that, the information is only seen by whoever handles your request at Forcelis.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: This site does not set advertising or tracking cookies.

If you switch languages with the selector, your choice is stored in your own browser so the site's root opens in that language next time. It is never sent to a server and you can delete it by clearing your browser data.
If web analytics is ever enabled, your consent will be requested before any third-party script loads. As of the date of this notice, no analytics service is active.

sections.title: How long it is kept
body: Requests are kept as long as needed to reply and, if a business relationship follows, for as long as that relationship requires. If you ask us to delete your data and there is no legal reason to keep it, we delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your personal data, object to its processing, and withdraw the consent you gave. Contact us through the channel below and we will reply.
Under Mexican data protection law these are known as ARCO rights.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
body: If this notice changes, the updated version is published on this page with a new date.

meta.title: Terms of Service — Forcelis
meta.description: Terms governing the use of the Forcelis website, its consulting services and the platform's launch offer.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of this website. Each consulting project and each platform account is also governed by the contract or terms signed for that service.

sections.title: Purpose of this site
body: This site describes Forcelis's consulting services and its analytics platform for advisors. It is informational. Nothing published here is professional advice you should act on without a conversation about your specific situation.

sections.title: Prices
body: Published prices are in Mexican pesos plus VAT, except those of the international line, which are in US dollars. The scope, final price and timing of each service are confirmed in writing before work starts. Services marked "Quote" have no published price.

sections.title: Platform launch offer
body: The first advisors who request it, up to the limit published on the Pricing page, use the stated plan at no cost for the stated number of months. There are no usage requirements or data upload deadlines.

In exchange, participants agree to give monthly feedback, a testimonial and to ask their clients for authorization for the anonymous benchmark; no client data enters the benchmark without that client's signed authorization.

When the free period ends, the plan's regular price applies, or the discount published on the Pricing page for the stated period if the advisor gave a testimonial. Forcelis may close the offer once the limit is reached.

sections.title: Illustrative figures
body: Every dashboard, score and metric shown on this site is illustrative and labeled as such. The figures do not describe any real company and should not be used as a reference for any decision.

sections.title: Scope of what Forcelis does
body: Forcelis provides analysis and consulting services and offers an analytics platform for advisors. It does not do bookkeeping, file tax returns or issue tax opinions, and it does not replace the judgment of a certified public accountant.
Forcelis does not provide legal, tax or immigration advice. When a project needs it — for example, a franchise agreement — the work is done by a partner lawyer whose fees are contracted separately.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The content, design, logo and name of this site belong to Forcelis Group. You may read it, quote it with attribution and share links. You may not reproduce the site or present its content as your own.

sections.title: Availability
body: The site is provided as is. We aim to keep it accurate and available, but we do not guarantee it is error-free or uninterrupted.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States.
